title: Alien Shooter
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: Alien shooter (descriptive title)
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Exact left/right payload; 59 ordered lines; consistent pointer base 17125; end marker; exact EOF
versions.startupSource:
5 RANDOM
7 DIMA(64),B(64)
10 CLS:A=5:S=3:P=10:Y=60
12 A$=STRING$(5,143)
20 FOR X=1TOA
30 A(X)=((INT((116/A)-INT(116/(A*2)))*X)-1)*2-2
35 IFA(X)>122THENA(X)=122ELSEIFA(X)<6THENA(X)=6
40 B(X)=0:NEXTX
50 PRINT"KEYS USED ARE ";CHR$(93);CHR$(94);"TO MOVE,CLEAR TO MAKE A NEW SHIELD,AND ENTER TO FIRE"
60 INPUT"PRESS ENTER TO START GAME";B$
70 CLS
80 '*SET UP GRAPHICS*

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
